AUTHOR: Dawkins, M; Prior, J; Lewis, B; Faillettaz, R; Banez, T; Salvi, M; Rollo, A; Simon, J; Campbell, M; Lucero, M; Chaudhary, A; Richards, B; Hoogs, A
TITLE: FishTrack23: An Ensemble Underwater Dataset for Multi-Object Tracking
VENUE: 2024 IEEE/CVF WINTER CONFERENCE ON APPLICATIONS OF COMPUTER VISION, WACV 2024
REGION: Bay of Biscay (France), northern Gulf of Mexico (USA), Lake Jennings California (USA), main Hawaiian islands (USA)
SPECIES: ~200 species labels (e.g., red snapper, Deep 7 bottomfish, black seabream, largemouth bass); detection/tracking as single 'fish' class
DATA: FishTrack23 ensemble: Ifremer DropCam, Game of Trawls, SEAMAP Reef Fish Video Survey, CDFW Habitat Monitoring, NOAA MOUSS
V_EV: Sec 2.1: 'Due to turbidity, fish may come in and out of visibility'; Sec 2.3.3: 'Data is typically collected at depths ranging from 15-200 m.'
D2: train 23k tracks / test 3.5k tracks; videos manually selected
D_EV: Sec 2.2: 'Videos were manually selected to generate this split, ensuring that both a range of difficulties and multiple locations were included in the test set.'
R_EV: Sec 4: 'For trackers, the same detection approach was used in each method (CRCNN-MS) and evaluated on the test set.' (single aggregated dataset test split)
C_EV: Sec 3: 'exceed a fixed detection score (default=0.5) ... A secondary pruning step compares overlaps on top of entire tracks to reduce duplicates.'
E_EV: Sec 4: 'we initially focused on utilizing MCC ... for classifiers, mAP ... for detectors, and IDF1 [31] for trackers.'
ARCH: Cascade R-CNN variants (CRCNN, multi-scale, motion); trackers TUT, SiamMask-MOT, ByteTrack; classifiers ResNeXt101, EfficientNetV2
NOTE: Video-level manual split across the ensemble; test includes multiple locations but they also appear in training, so not external. Depth and lighting (ambient vs artificial, 4x2000 lumens) described per subset but no stratified results. C5 credited for explicit duplicate-reduction mechanism (track overlap pruning, cross-tile NMS) with default score 0.5; threshold is a default (would be N without C5). Game of Trawls subset is in-trawl prototype. Includes NOAA SEAMAP (SEAMAPD21 updated).
